## KEY POINT

Once trainees have learned the movement patterns of basic resistance training exercises, they should use a variety of exercises to maximize whole-body muscle hypertrophy. This should include free-form as well as machine-based exercises. Similarly, both multi- and single-joint exercises should be included in hypertrophy-specific routines to maximize muscular growth.
